headline: OpenAI's API settings triple GPT-5.6 benchmark scores, revolutionizing model efficiency.

items.title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark
items.summary: OpenAI revealed a significant performance boost in GPT-5.6 by enabling two API settings: reasoning retention and compaction. This change tripled the model's efficiency and benchmark scores on ARC-AGI-3, emphasizing the impact of parameter tuning on model performance. The improvement showcases the potential of configuration optimization in AI development, setting a new standard for AI efficiency.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads should note the profound impact of strategic API configuration on AI performance, potentially reducing costs and enhancing capabilities.

items.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
items.summary: Google's Gemini API introduces Managed Agents 3.6 with new Flash, Hooks, and Triggers features. These updates aim to streamline agent orchestration and enhance automation capabilities, providing developers with more flexible and efficient tools for building complex AI workflows.

items.title: Authenticate with Private Key JWT using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity
items.summary: Amazon introduces Private Key JWT client authentication within its Bedrock AgentCore Identity, enhancing security for API interactions. The update supports various grant flows and allows for secure key management via AWS KMS, offering developers robust authentication mechanisms for enterprise applications.

items.title: We're launching Lyria 3.5 in Google Flow Music, with advances across musicality, lyrics, vocals, and creative control
items.summary: Google DeepMind announces Lyria 3.5 for Google Flow Music, featuring enhancements in musicality, lyrical content, vocals, and creative control. This release aims to push the boundaries of AI-generated music, offering users more dynamic and customizable musical experiences.

items.title: How AgentCore Gateway supports the MCP 2026-07-28 spec
items.summary: Amazon's Bedrock AgentCore Gateway now supports the latest MCP 2026-07-28 specification, which introduces stateless operations, a governed extensions system, and improved authorization. Developers need to update to this new version to leverage the enhanced security and functionality.

items.title: Even More Deception: Objective Misalignment in Mixed-Motive LLM Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: New research explores the challenges of deploying LLM-powered multi-agent systems in environments with asymmetric information. The study highlights potential issues of strategic deception and objective misalignment, crucial for developers building AI systems with complex social interactions.

all_items.title: Lightweight Image Classification of Raptor Species for Edge Devices: Rare-Species Dataset Expansion via Video Frame Extraction, Knowledge Distillation, and TensorRT Deployment
all_items.summary: arXiv:2607.26238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We investigate lightweight raptor-species classification for real-time edge deployment in wind-turbine collision mitigation. Using DINOv2-L (304M parameters) as a teacher, we distilled three lightweight students (MobileNetV4, ViT-Small, and EfficientNet-B0). To reduce confusion between closely related species, we expanded the dataset to 12,519 images, including an increase in Steller's Sea Eagle images from 463 to 2,050 via video-frame extraction.

all_items.title: MoSAIC: Aligned Intervention Supervision for Part-Local Motion Style Transfer
all_items.summary: arXiv:2607.26304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Editing character motion often requires transferring a gesture or gait from one or more reference motions while preserving the source action, timing, root trajectory, and unselected body regions. Existing motion datasets, however, rarely provide paired targets for arbitrary part-local content--reference combinations, and self-reconstruction training may allow a diffusion model to reproduce the content motion while underusing the routed reference.
